method: All old-hit/new-unhit lines; sum min(covered_before,total-covered_after) on every mapped branch line, plus that formula on the exact global collector unmapped remainder. New hits never offset losses.
assumptions: One complete affected-test filter is used on both revisions.
Production code, test configuration, production DLL/PDB scope, and unchanged-test behavior are identical, as separately verified by the caller.
Unmapped branch identities are not known; the collector remainder is treated as one global set.
limitations: Cobertura package nodes expose truncated branch rates, not exact assembly branch counters. No rate is converted into an exact count.

Per-assembly bounds allow the entire global unmapped remainder in each assembly, tighten covered-before/uncovered-after maxima using Coverlet 6.0.4 truncated-rate intervals [rate,rate+0.0001), and divide by the mapped branch denominator lower bound. Independent assembly worst cases are not summed into the global bound.
A bound above the limit is inconclusive about actual loss, not proof of a coverage regression. No fallback action is selected by this script.

exporter_rate_precision_evidence.rule: CoverageDetails.Percent = Math.Floor((Covered/Total)*10000)/100; CoberturaReporter emits Percent/100. Boundary calculations expand by 1e-12 in ratio and 1e-9 in count.
